title: Reactions from All Sides
next_chapter_hook: Ye Qing's voice transmitted through the Sound-Transmitting Talisman, carrying an irrepressible gravity: 'Chen Ji, the Demonic Path Commander is near the secret realm—and he has already locked onto your aura.'

text.content: The burning sensation pierced into the depths of his soul like a branding iron. Chen Ji endured the excruciating pain, pressing one hand against his chest, fingertips touching the Jade Slip that radiated warmth like burning coals. The light from the third page of the Tianji Record flickered uncertainly in his Mental Sea. Mo Xiansheng's words 'It has found you' stabbed his heart like an ice awl. Heavenly Fate Value: only 23 points remaining. If Heaven's Eye truly locked onto him, every subsequent vision could become a death sentence.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing his churning thoughts. His fingers gently traced the Jade Slip, sending a thought only he could perceive: 'Who is it? The Tianji Record or Heaven's Eye?' Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, even more ethereal than before: 'The Tianji Record is its eye. The fragment in your hand is merely bait it cast into the world... The time is not yet right, I cannot say more.' The moment his voice faded, the Jade Slip's temperature dropped sharply, as if the earlier burning heat had been nothing but an illusion.

Meanwhile, deep within the Tianqing Sect Forbidden Grounds. Ling Yuan sat cross-legged in the center of a Eight Trigrams Formation, spiritual lights swirling around him like silk threads. Suddenly, his brow center twitched slightly, and a gleam of sharpness flashed in those murky old eyes—the fluctuations from the secret realm's direction resonated with the wisp of divine sense he had planted months ago. 'Interesting.' Ling Yuan let out a low laugh, his withered fingers tracing a talisman in the void, 'So Chen Xuan's successor finally couldn't hold back?'

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan withdrew the talisman, squinting toward the secret realm's direction, a playful smile playing at the corner of his lips. 'No rush. Let this old man see what tricks you can pull.' His voice was unhurried, yet a ruthlessness unbefitting his age flickered across his aged face, 'That boy's secrets far exceed what he reveals... But this chess game hasn't reached its endgame yet.'

text.content: Ling Yuan closed his eyes, the spiritual lights around him gradually收敛, returning to silence. He made his decision—watch and wait. The upheaval had come too suddenly; whether it was the secret realm's strange mutation or Heaven's Eye's intervention, it all exceeded his expectations. Rather than act rashly and expose his trump cards, he would bide his time and wait for the early bird to stir up the waters.

A thousand miles away, the Demonic Holy Sect's temporary camp. Ye Qing stood in the command tent, her slender fingers gripping a jet-black Sound-Transmitting Talisman, her brow furrowed. The message in the talisman left her uneasy—Commander Mo Wuji had led three thousand elite soldiers away from the main camp silently, destination unknown. She had witnessed the Commander's methods before; he was a ruthless man who would do anything to achieve his goals. When he moved, there was always a plan.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's fingertips surged with spiritual energy, forcibly activating the Sound-Transmitting Talisman to contact the hidden operatives within the Holy Sect. A moment later, her face turned deathly pale. 'Impossible...' she murmured to herself, 'The Commander's marching direction is toward the secret realm!' Mo Wuji had received the news earlier than her, or rather, he had been waiting for this opportunity. And Chen Ji was currently at the center of that storm.

text.content: Ye Qing abruptly lifted the tent curtain, her voice cold as she said to the servant outside: 'Prepare the Spiritual Vessel, I need to go out.' The servant looked up in shock, but was forced back by Ye Qing's icy gaze. However, the moment she was about to step out of the tent, a sinister voice drifted from the shadows: 'Your Highness the Saint, the Commander has ordered that you should not go out these few days.' Ye Qing's footsteps halted, a cold gleam suddenly appearing in her eyes—she had been placed under house arrest.

Ye Qing forced herself to remain calm, slowly retreating into the tent. The owner of that voice lurked in the shadows like a venomous snake, watching her every move. Her cooperation with Chen Ji had always been dancing on the edge of a blade; now that the Commander had personally intervened, any rash action on her part would only implicate that person. Her fingers quietly twisted a backup Sound-Transmitting Talisman hidden in her sleeve as she made her decision—to relay the message through unconventional channels.

dialogue.content: A moment later, the Sound-Transmitting Talisman in Chen Ji's hand suddenly grew warm. When his divine sense probed inside, Ye Qing's voice, carrying suppressed urgency, penetrated his ears: 'Chen Ji, the Demonic Path Commander Mo Wuji has already taken people toward the secret realm. I'm under house arrest and cannot leave, but he seems to have known all along that you would appear there—be careful, this is a trap!' The transmission cut off abruptly, clearly indicating that Ye Qing's situation was far more dangerous than she had described.

text.content: Chen Ji gripped the Sound-Transmitting Talisman tightly, his expression unchanged on the surface, but his heart was already churning like a tempest. Mo Wuji, the foremost battle general of the Demonic Holy Sect, reportedly had cultivation already approaching Transcendence Peak, just one step from Tribulation. Such a figure coming specifically for him was obviously no coincidence. The vague images he had seen using the Tianji Record—the Demonic Path army, the secret realm's mutation—now reassembled in his mind like scattered fragments,拼出一个令人不寒而栗的真相拼出一个令人不寒而栗的真相,拼出一个令人不寒而栗的真相: someone had betrayed their whereabouts.

Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, beginning to deduce rapidly. Ling Yuan was watching, Ye Qing was under house arrest, the Demonic Path Commander personally intervened, and Heaven's Eye happened to lock onto his aura at this moment—all these events happening simultaneously could not possibly be coincidence. He opened his eyes, a flash of sharpness in his gaze. 'Mo Xiansheng, can the Tianji Record help me see through Mo Wuji's layout?' In his Mental Sea, Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment: 'With your current Heavenly Fate Value, you can barely glimpse one hour into the future... But are you certain you want to take this risk?'

choices.description: Use the Tianji Record to foresee the future, getting ahead to understand Mo Wuji's layout and find a way to break the deadlock before the enemy closes in. The risk is extremely high, but it won't expose the relationship with Ye Qing.

choices.visible_reward: Gain key intelligence, seize the initiative

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no longer. The Tianji Record in his palm suddenly grew scalding hot. Mo Xiansheng sighed, and an ancient divine sense entered his Mental Sea—the images began to distort, like peering into the future through murky water. He saw a pitch-black forest, thousands of black shadows swarming like ants, and a man in black armor standing with his back to him, strange purple flames resting on his shoulders.

choices.description: Contact Ye Qing through unconventional channels, breaking the deadlock with coordinated attacks from inside and outside. Needs to risk Ye Qing's exposure, but the odds of success are greater.
choices.visible_cost: May implicate Ye Qing, leading to exposure of the cooperative relationship
choices.visible_reward: Gain intelligence from within the Demonic Path, reducing the risk of being surrounded and killed
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing is currently under house arrest, and contacting her is inherently full of variables.

text.content: Chen Ji flipped the voice transmission talisman, injecting Spiritual Energy into a hidden vibration. This was a backup contact method Ye Qing had left him, using the forbidden frequency of the Holy Sect—ordinary cultivators couldn't possibly intercept it. After a moment, the talisman warmed slightly, and Ye Qing's voice rang out again, carrying a suppressed tremor: 'You... are you insane, contacting me this way?'

No matter which path he chose, Chen Ji understood one thing clearly: passive waiting meant only death. He tucked the transmission talisman into his sleeve, his gaze fixed on the western region of the secret realm—where the demonic army was most likely to appear. Ye Qing's warning still echoed in his ears, Mo Xiansheng's sighs lingered, the Heavenly Eye's threat hung over him like a sword. He clenched his fist, and an inexplicable calm surged within him. The more desperate the situation, the calmer he must remain—this was the first lesson Chen Xuan had taught him.

Chen Ji slipped silently from the hidden cave, his form vanishing into the dense forest like a specter. The Tianji Record within him radiated faint warmth, the remnant soul of Mo Xiansheng shrouding his presence; otherwise, with his Foundation Building cultivation, he would have been completely exposed in this environment teeming with powerful beings. 'Go east thirty li,' Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out, 'there's an underground river. If you want to set an ambush, that's the best location—but you only have half an hour.'

Chen Ji offered no reply, only quickening his pace. Half an hour—he had to complete his preparations within half an hour, or Mo Wujiu's army would seal off all his escape routes. He recalled those blurred visions from the Tianji Record—the black-armored man with his back turned, the purple flames on his shoulder... Those weren't ordinary flames; they were the supreme mark of the Holy Sect, something only commander-level figures could bear.

Suddenly, a sharp whistling sound pierced the air from behind. Chen Ji ducked low as a black arrow grazed his hair, embedding itself in the tree trunk ahead, its fletching still trembling. 'Chen Ji—' A cold, sinister voice resounded from all directions, like a phantom's whisper, 'The commander has ordered: no capture. Kill on sight.' Before the words finished, over a dozen shadowy figures emerged simultaneously from all sides, surrounding him completely.

Chen Ji steadied himself, surveying the surroundings. These demonic cultivators had varied cultivation levels—the strongest merely at Foundation Building peak, the weakest even at Qi Refining stage—but their positioning was extremely clever, clearly the result of rigorous training, blocking every possible escape route. 'Mo Wujiu really thinks highly of me.' Chen Ji chuckled lightly, his voice unhurried, 'Sending so many to surround and kill a 'waste'—isn't your commander being overly cautious?'

dialogue.content: The lead black-clad cultivator snorted coldly: 'Waste? There aren't many people in this world who would make the commander issue a personal kill order.' He raised his hand, and over a dozen shadows struck simultaneously. Artifacts' Spiritual Light intertwined into a killing net so dense it seemed impenetrable. Chen Ji's pupils contracted; as his body surged backward, the Tianji Record within him roared—Mo Xiansheng's urgent voice cried out: 'Three zhang to your left, there's a gap!'

text.content: Chen Ji didn't hesitate; his form flashed like lightning toward the left. Mo Xiansheng hadn't lied—a gap nearly imperceptible to the naked eye existed there. A talisman had somehow appeared in his hand; Spiritual Energy propelled it, and the talisman transformed into a streak of golden light, directly blasting two black-clad cultivators away before they could react. But his face simultaneously drained of color—forcibly activating the Tianji Record's foresight of the gap had cost him 3 more points of Heavenly Fate.

Heavenly Fate remained at only fifteen points. Chen Ji gritted his teeth, his form never stopping as he fled deeper into the forest. Behind him came furious shouts and relentless footsteps in pursuit. He couldn't stop, couldn't look back; every pause could mean death. Yet his mind was calculating rapidly—this group was merely the vanguard; Mo Wujiu's main force still followed. If he couldn't find a way to break through before the main force closed in, today would be his death.

Just then, the backup transmission talisman in his embrace suddenly grew warm. Ye Qing's voice rang out like a heavenly melody, carrying irrepressible urgency: 'Chen Ji, the demonic commander is near the secret realm—and he has already locked onto your aura!' Chen Ji's steps halted abruptly, his expression shifting slightly. Locked onto his aura? This meant wherever he ran, Mo Wujiu could precisely locate him. Ye Qing's intelligence had come timely, but it also made him fully recognize reality: he was already marked.

Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. Locked onto his aura? This might not be a bad thing. Mo Wujiu had personally intervened, showing how seriously he viewed this operation—and seriousness meant caution, caution meant—he wouldn't easily approach a 'waste'. A subtle smile curved Chen Ji's lips, a meaningful glint in his eyes. Since he was to be treated as a waste, he'd let Mo Wujiu see clearly exactly what this 'waste' could accomplish that would shake heaven and earth.

Chen Ji abruptly stopped, turning to face the pursuers behind him. The lead black-clad cultivator clearly hadn't expected him to suddenly halt, his artifact nearly losing control. 'What, has the waste come to his senses?' He sneered coldly, 'If you know what's good for you, come quietly with us—perhaps we can leave your corpse intact.' Chen Ji tilted his head, his smile growing increasingly gentle: 'Your commander ordered immediate execution, which means he's very afraid of me surviving. Since that's the case...' He paused, his voice suddenly turning cold, 'How could I possibly let him have his way?'

Before the words finished, Chen Ji forcefully activated the Spiritual Energy within him, his aura suddenly surging. Though merely at Foundation Building peak cultivation, theimposing that erupted in that instant caused all the black-clad cultivators to change expressions drastically. What terrified them even more was the black jade talisman that had somehow appeared in Chen Ji's hand—the Holy Sect sacred maiden's emergency beacon! 'Princess Ye Qing, would you please have your commander explain why Her Highness the Sacred Maiden would protect a 'waste'?' Chen Ji raised the talisman high, smiling innocently, 'I believe he would very much like to know the answer.'
